description: Call after all bytes have uploaded. For a ChatGPT import, use its assetId as uploadId and its completionKey as idempotencyKey. If preparing is true, wait and retry the same completion with that key. This validates the source without starting translation.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable unique key for this operation. Reuse it with the exact same input after a timeout; never generate a new key to retry.

uploadId.description: The exact resource ID returned by DubSync, including any colon prefix.

name: dub_complete_upload
title: Complete a media upload
